initiative.title: Backlog Taskset Test Recovery
initiative.summary: Restore PR #303 package CI after the real-backlog classification test fell behind newly registered tasksets.

taskset.summary: Update the canonical real-backlog taskset expectation for all newly registered tasksets and prove the full package suite remains green.

tasks.title: Synchronize the real-backlog taskset expectation
tasks.goal: Make the real-backlog classification test recognize every taskset registered by the July remediation and PR #303 CI-recovery work.
tasks.scope: Update only the expected taskset IDs in tests/test_backlog_board_tasksets.py. Do not change backlog parsing, task classification behavior, or production code.
acceptance: The expected set includes TASKSET-AR-JULY-RELEASE-IMPACT-REMEDIATION, TASKSET-AR-PR303-CI-SCHEMA-RECOVERY, and TASKSET-AR-BACKLOG-TASKSET-TEST-RECOVERY.
The focused backlog taskset test passes.
The full tests suite passes under the same PYTHONPATH=src invocation used by CI.

units.title: Add newly registered tasksets to the exact-set regression test
units.context: GitHub Actions run 29909181630 reported one failure: test_real_backlog_tasks_are_classified_into_registered_task_sets rejected two newly registered tasksets. Registering this recovery taskset adds one more legitimate ID that the same exact-set assertion must include.
units.scope: Add exactly the three newly registered taskset IDs to the expected set. No production-code changes and no weakening from exact equality to subset checks.
steps: Confirm the actual extra IDs from the CI failure and taskset registry.
Add the three registered IDs to the exact expected set.
Run the focused test and full package suite.
Run taskset, RBAC, classifier, and Owner governance gates.
acceptance: Exact-set assertion remains exact and passes with every currently registered taskset.
No file outside the test and generated governance records changes.
units.handoff: Provide focused/full pytest counts, exact verified HEAD, and independent W4b evidence.
units.stop_condition: Stop if the actual taskset registry contains any additional unplanned ID or if fixing the failure requires production classifier changes.
